label: retailer sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: On first load a welcome dialog and a cookie dialog were both open at once. Focus started on the Privacy Policy link inside the cookie dialog, and I had to find both dialogs and close each one.

After I declined cookies and dismissed the welcome dialog, focus went back to the top of the page, then a newsletter popup opened when I moved to Add to bag. I had to dismiss a third overlay before I could shop.
After I pressed No thanks on the newsletter popup, focus landed on the unrelated link Holiday Fragrance Kits far down the page instead of returning to where I was.

Many product links are named only with a URL path, for example /en-es/products/balm-dotcom-keychain?variant=..., and a few other links are unnamed or named oddly (Click to navigate to Balm dotcom page, Video: Video player). The same products also appear twice in the list, which is confusing.

Pressing Add to bag only changed the button to Adding to bag... and dropped focus to the top of the page. I did not hear that the item was added. I only found it by re-reading, when the Bag count changed to 1 and a cart drawer appeared with no clear announcement and focus on a button named Retailer O.

After choosing Checkout the page showed only a banner and an empty main region, with no loading message. I had to read again to find the form. The Delivery section is preset to Spain, and the shop shows prices in euros even though the task asked for a US address, so I would have to change the country by hand. The card fields are inside iframes.

findings.problem: On first load a welcome dialog and a cookie dialog were both open at once. Focus started on the Privacy Policy link inside the cookie dialog, and I had to find both dialogs and close each one.

After I declined cookies and dismissed the welcome dialog, focus went back to the top of the page, then a newsletter popup opened when I moved to Add to bag. I had to dismiss a third overlay before I could shop.
After I pressed No thanks on the newsletter popup, focus landed on the unrelated link Holiday Fragrance Kits far down the page instead of returning to where I was.

Many product links are named only with a URL path, for example /en-es/products/balm-dotcom-keychain?variant=..., and a few other links are unnamed or named oddly (Click to navigate to Balm dotcom page, Video: Video player). The same products also appear twice in the list, which is confusing.

Pressing Add to bag only changed the button to Adding to bag... and dropped focus to the top of the page. I did not hear that the item was added. I only found it by re-reading, when the Bag count changed to 1 and a cart drawer appeared with no clear announcement and focus on a button named Retailer O.

After choosing Checkout the page showed only a banner and an empty main region, with no loading message. I had to read again to find the form. The Delivery section is preset to Spain, and the shop shows prices in euros even though the task asked for a US address, so I would have to change the country by hand. The card fields are inside iframes.
